_comment: Documented historical / superseded / purged numeric values.
scripts/audit_project.py check 5 loads this file so that values which are
INTENTIONALLY quoted as wrong, old, or removed are not flagged as unmatched.
Every entry must state why it is retained and what replaced it.
Nothing here may ever be presented as a current result.

purged_fake_results.reason: Fabricated Phase 3 baseline / benchmark-matrix / 5-fold CV numbers, removed on 2026-10-15. Artifacts moved to outputs/_invalid/. Quoted ONLY in the README purge notice.

pre_fix_metric_artifacts.reason: Values produced by evaluator bugs fixed in v0.2.1 (101-point AP envelope off-by-1/101 for zero-TP classes; frame PR-AUC endpoint interpolation). Retained as historical bug descriptions only.

corrected_documented_values.reason: Values the docs quote ONLY as the wrong/old figure being corrected, so the correction can be read as evidence. Never to be presented as current.

superseded_bootstrap_cis.reason: Bootstrap 95% CIs computed over the WRONG patient universe (frames_index.csv: 31,499 frames / 42 patients) instead of the canonical eval set (722 frames / 6 patients for val, 852 / 6 for test). Superseded on 2026-10-16.

decisive_test_gap_values.reason: Decisive test comparing custom predictor 512x512 vs 544_padded vs native Ultralytics val (0.0109 vs 0.0270 vs 0.0438 on val; 0.0095 vs 0.0107 on test). Padding 512 into 544 closes ~50% of the gap on val (2.5x increase from 0.0109 to 0.0270), locating the sensitivity to preprocessing padding, but leaving the remaining gap to 0.0438 unresolved.

invalidated_frame_screening_shortcut.reason: ResNet18 frame classifier (AUC 0.8781 val, 0.9289 test) and video screening (AUC 0.9107 val, 0.9339 test) results marked INVALID due to angiographer keyframe-selection shortcut. Model learned contrast injection and vessel density cues rather than CAD lesion pathology.
